meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问某条 senpi 提示(Tip: 行)是什么意思或对应功能怎么运作时,它先查实时提示清单、读你的设置确认你本人能看到哪些,再读实现代码,给出带文件路径的深入解释。
howto.when: 当你问起某条提示、某个被提示的功能做什么,或想知道以你的配置能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会先查清单和你的设置再解释

say.text: 这条提示对应哪个功能,它实际怎么实现的?
以我现在的设置,我能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 只报你能见到的,不给整份目录

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip (a 'Tip:' line), it first checks the live tip list and reads your settings to see which tips you can actually see, then reads the real implementation code and explains that exact tip in depth with file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see with your setup.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Checks the tip list and your settings first.

say_en.text: Which feature is this tip about, and how does it work?
say_en.note: Reads the implementation code before answering.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see with my config?
say_en.note: Reports your gated set, not the full catalog.
